settings.intro: Add a token for each integration, then copy a webhook URL and send events to your team or channel.
settings.footer: Select Save tokens to apply token changes. Use Save at the bottom for the other settings.
settings.WebhookTokens.label: Webhook Tokens
settings.WebhookTools.label: Webhook URLs & Test
settings.RequireSignedWebhooks.label: Require Signed Webhooks
settings.RequireSignedWebhooks.help: Require signatures for every token and the legacy secret. Enable only after all senders support signing. When disabled, individual tokens can still require a signature.
settings.WebhookSecret.label: Webhook Secret (legacy)
settings.WebhookSecret.help: For existing integrations that share one secret. This secret has no team or channel restrictions. Use a token above for new integrations.
settings.MaxEventsStored.label: Maximum Events Stored
settings.MaxEventsStored.help: Events kept per team. Once this limit is reached, the oldest events are removed.
settings.MaxEventsDisplayed.label: Maximum Events Displayed
settings.MaxEventsDisplayed.help: Maximum number of events loaded per request. Users can load older events in the timeline.
settings.TimelineOrder.label: Timeline Order
settings.TimelineOrder.help: Choose whether new events appear at the top or bottom of the timeline.
settings.EnableReactions.label: Enable Reactions
settings.EnableReactions.help: Let users add reactions to timeline events.
admin.invalidArray: Invalid Webhook Tokens JSON: expected an array of token objects.
admin.invalidJSON: Invalid Webhook Tokens JSON: fix the saved value before editing tokens.
admin.name: Name
admin.nameHelp: A unique name for this integration. Used as the event source when the sender omits source.
admin.secretHelp: New or renamed tokens need a secret before they can be enabled. Leave blank to keep an existing token's secret.
admin.teamHelp: Leave blank for any team, or enter one team name or ID.
admin.channelsHelp: Leave blank for all channels and team-wide events. To restrict delivery, list channel names or IDs separated by commas or new lines. The sender must include allowed channels in its payload.
admin.pauseHelp: Uncheck Accept events to pause this integration without deleting its token.
admin.sendIntro: Copy a webhook URL below and replace its team_id value with a team name or ID. Send a JSON body with a title, for example:
admin.unsignedHelp: For unsigned requests, send the token's secret in the X-Webhook-Secret header.
admin.signedHelp: When signatures are required, send X-Timeline-Timestamp (Unix seconds) and X-Timeline-Signature. Sign the timestamp, a dot and the exact request body with HMAC-SHA256 and the token secret:
admin.timestampHelp: Use a fresh timestamp for each request. Timestamps outside a five-minute window and repeated signatures are rejected.
admin.loadTokensFailed: Failed to load webhook token credentials
admin.saveTokensFailed: Failed to save webhook token credentials
admin.tokensIntro: Create one token per integration. Give it a name and secret, then choose which teams and channels it can publish to.
admin.noTokens: No tokens yet. Select Add token to connect your first integration.
admin.clipboardFailed: Clipboard is not available in this browser
admin.endpointsHelp: Use the webhook URL for one event, or the batch URL for up to 50 events.
admin.testHelp: Create an event in the selected team or channel. This checks timeline delivery, not webhook authentication or signatures.
admin.networkError: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
admin.error.unauthorized: Sign in to manage timeline settings.
admin.error.invalid_token_config: The saved token configuration is invalid.
admin.error.encode_token_config: Unable to encode the token configuration.
admin.error.save_token_config: Unable to save the token configuration.
